subject.title: Feishu card action: pass through form_value, input_value and other fields

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu card-action callbacks use for `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, and `options` while preserving existing button command extraction?
rationale: The source-level data loss is clear, but choosing JSON text, command-string tokens, or a narrower channel/plugin envelope changes what agents and user workflows must parse.

options.title: Settle the contract on the linked PR
options.body: Use the open linked PR or a replacement branch to preserve all requested fields with a documented, tested payload shape and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Narrow to command-compatible form fields
options.body: Only append fields that fit the existing command-text path, reducing compatibility risk but leaving some structured card data less useful.

options.title: Defer broad pass-through
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers decide that exposing raw or structured card callback payloads is an intended Feishu channel contract.

recommendation.title: Settle the contract on the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the open linked PR or a replacement branch to preserve all requested fields with a documented, tested payload shape and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained contact for the affected plugin contract.
